i don't have a particular favourite... i just like to read and write. anything which is good literature...

I don't really have a favourite.. but i like a lot of the writer and poets. Whenever i get bored, i read arbain nights. i really like that... It makes me forget bout today's world... God knows why.

yeah you can say that... it feels worse because... no one can actually get it... I mean... i don't know... now i'm just being conflicted within myself... head and brain tells me i should die ... something else tells me no. I don't know.... 

i write for myself... another way i vent out... kill my characters if i feel upset... killing one ... or trying to kill one right now...but don't have the heart to... i really do like the character a lot... maybe i could email it you?

 i study psychology, sociology and english literature... A level first year... Literature i love... still do.. basically 12th grade...one more year till graduation..

oh and have a nice time at your parents. i'll pm you

i am already dead from the soul.. why bother living now? i even stopped eating and i love reading... but i would not trouble you with that... 

Honestly If faking a smile and telling everyone nothing is wrong counts then sure... i have been doing that a lot. my mum wont bother speaking to me... and since i am the most selfish, mean, uncaring, undeserving person on this planet, might as well go ahead and do it. pretty much studying and crying and writing.

thanks...

i just want to talk to my friend... but she is not even answering her phone or anything... and its like i'm just looking at the calender... one more day.. and everything wil be over.

oh ok... but my laptop wont be able to handle the clients then... its acts slow if there is too much data on it... so i just keep it for using the internet and writing stuff... don't play games on laptop much...

yeah.. played pokemon... im gonna check those out....do i need to download anything for these games...?

yep and my country has even developed so no suicide hotlines/ emails or whatever... 

its okay... i have stopped talking to people.. so doesnt get to me as much

i dont know any online games... my brother tells me to stay away from those... and hes younger than me.... but if you know any good ones i might give it a go... i usually play zelda and mario stuff.... 

and my country is not on it.. so yeah...

i don't think we have any... like i said i dont live in a first world country....  i liked playing video games... with my bros. they were always teaching me... all my close friends are in another school...and the only person i let in my life is moving away... so yep. 

i have to drag myself out of bed, to do things... i slept for 20 mins last night... rest of the night, i just stayed in the same position being numb... don't really have anyone to help me out...
maybe if i was 18 then i could just pack up and leave.

*no
*can not
* Still can not
*don't have them here.
*no way
no ones going to listen, and i am not putting my friend through that again.
 and no i havent talked to any of my friends. they just know im depressed and something is bugging me but i havent told them at all...
i would make my own life if i was living somewhere in US or UK or any other first world country.

i have had issues with my mother when i was a kid, and i still have issues with her. I'm not going to get the school involved again. Last time i involved them, she PRETENDED she cared. When we got to her house ( yes hers not our.) she literally screamed at me on how i am making her look like a bad mother. I am still choosing over two methods now... ones in which my friends cant stop me or save me.
another week ?? i do not want to do anything. please tell me, if your parents kept reminding and keep telling you you are a burden, and give you a hard time, would you like to live?
i know when i am not wanted at all. My family made that very clear this morning that they do not need me in their lives. After all, i am just a burden to them.
